simplecoords.config.enabled.tooltip: Whether the SimpleCoords HUD should be displayed on screen.
simplecoords.config.use_camera.tooltip: If enabled, the HUD will show the camera's coordinates (useful for Freecam). If disabled, it always shows the player's body coordinates.
simplecoords.config.show_xyz.tooltip: Display the X, Y, and Z coordinates.
simplecoords.config.show_facing.tooltip: Display the cardinal direction you are facing.
simplecoords.config.precision.tooltip: Number of decimal places for XYZ coordinates (0 for whole numbers).
simplecoords.config.x.tooltip: The horizontal position of the HUD.
simplecoords.config.y.tooltip: The vertical position of the HUD.
